economy.summary: Her campaign platform proposes banning junk fees and requiring transparent all-in pricing, strengthening price-gouging protections for essentials such as housing, groceries, and utilities, and preventing utility companies from passing infrastructure costs onto ratepayers.
economy.short: Proposes banning junk fees, strengthening price-gouging and utility protections.

taxes.summary: Her platform proposes increasing state education funding to reduce reliance on local property taxes, capping year-to-year property tax increases, expanding homestead relief, and creating a property tax freeze for seniors and residents on fixed incomes.
taxes.short: Proposes property tax caps, homestead relief, senior tax freeze.

abortion.summary: Said in an April 2024 candidate interview that she supports abortion access and opposes changing Pennsylvania's 24-week limit, and that she favors eliminating the spousal notice requirement and allowing trained nurse practitioners to perform abortions.
abortion.short: Supports abortion access; opposes changing Pennsylvania's 24-week limit.

education.summary: Said during her 2024 campaign that she advocates fair funding across all public schools and addressing funding gaps, while avoiding wasteful spending.
education.short: Advocates fair funding across all public schools.

healthcare.summary: Says she focuses on expanding affordable, accessible health care, especially for working families, citing her advocacy for the Lymphedema Treatment Act, which expanded insurance coverage for lymphedema care.
healthcare.short: Focuses on expanding affordable, accessible health care for working families.

energy.summary: Her platform proposes prohibiting large AI data centers from shifting costs to ratepayers, requiring independent environmental and economic impact studies before such projects are approved, and giving communities final say over major development projects.
energy.short: Proposes restricting data centers; impact studies; community final say.

guns.summary: Said in an April 2024 candidate interview that she supports universal background checks on gun sales and banning ghost guns.
guns.short: Supports universal background checks and banning ghost guns.

economy.summary: Her campaign says she will stop what it calls job-crushing regulations, support energy independence, and stand with workers, and that she would implement policies to create good-paying jobs for Luzerne County workers.
economy.short: Says she will stop regulations, support workers, create jobs.

taxes.summary: Her campaign platform says she will hold the line on broad-based taxes so taxpayers keep more of their money, and describes her as a fiscal conservative with over 25 years of business experience.
taxes.short: Says she will hold the line on broad-based taxes.

abortion.summary: Said in an April 2024 candidate interview that she opposes abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or to save the mother's life, and that improving viability technology may warrant reducing Pennsylvania's 24-week limit.
abortion.short: Opposes abortion with rape, incest, life exceptions; open to shorter limit.

education.summary: Her campaign platform says she will give parents more control and focus on catching up kids who have fallen behind at school.
education.short: Says she supports parental control; catching up students who fell behind.

healthcare.summary: In 2024 campaign statements she called rising suicide rates an epidemic and said more resources are needed so people struggling can seek help; her current campaign platform does not detail broader healthcare positions.
healthcare.short: Called suicide an epidemic; wants more mental health resources.

energy.summary: In a July 2025 statement on the state budget, said Pennsylvania should expand its energy sector to drive job creation and strengthen the economy.
energy.short: Says Pennsylvania should expand its energy sector for jobs.

guns.summary: Said in an April 2024 candidate interview that she opposes further gun regulation, saying additional restrictions only affect law-abiding gun owners.
guns.short: Opposes further gun regulation; says restrictions affect law-abiding owners.
